version.changelog: Initial release: comprehensive Feishu/Lark integration - docs, chat, files, screenshots, permissions, reminders

llm.summary: This Feishu skill is a coherent integration, but it bundles sensitive chat, document, screenshot, permission, and scheduled-message powers with limited scoping and privacy safeguards.

dimensions.detail: Using Feishu API credentials and outbound Feishu API calls is expected, but the requested app scopes cover documents, uploads, messaging, and optional permission management, so least-privilege setup is essential.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill with no bundled executable installer; setup requires the user to create a Feishu app and provide FEISHU_APP_ID and FEISHU_APP_SECRET.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Several sensitive operations are under-scoped: chat-history summarization has no explicit authorization or privacy check, screenshot capture is full-screen by default, and broad trigger phrases could activate the skill in contexts where the user did not intend high-impact Feishu actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The cron reminder template creates durable recurring outbound messages and only requires confirmation of frequency and target, leaving persistence, content review, and revocation safeguards under-specified.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose matches the capabilities, but the combined authority is high impact: it can read/write documents, fetch group chat history, upload local files and screenshots, manage document permissions, and send recurring Feishu messages.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing. Use a dedicated Feishu app with the minimum scopes needed, protect and rotate the app secret, and require explicit confirmation before chat-history access, screenshot capture, file upload, permission changes, or scheduled reminders. Avoid enabling permission-management or screenshot features unless you specifically need them.
llm.findings:
[PE3] expected: Feishu app credentials and tenant access tokens are necessary for this integration, but the breadth of document, messaging, upload, and permission scopes makes credential handling materially sensitive.
[SQP-2] expected: Screenshot sending is an advertised feature, but the artifact shows full macOS screenshot capture and upload without an explicit per-use privacy warning or crop/redaction guidance.
[P3] expected: Scheduled Feishu reminders fit the stated purpose, but the cron template creates persistent recurring outbound messages with limited safeguards beyond frequency and target confirmation.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Generic triggers such as feishu, lark, and common Chinese phrases are broader than needed for a skill with chat-history, screenshot, file-upload, permission, and reminder authority.
[E1] expected: The external POST to open.feishu.cn is the documented Feishu authentication endpoint and is expected for this integration, not independent evidence of malicious exfiltration.
[SQP-2] expected: Fetching group chat history is part of the stated feature set, but the artifact does not instruct the agent to confirm the user's authorization or limit/redact sensitive conversation content before summarizing.
